value.rationale: A motivated exact paired boundary of the published ladder matching-complex problem: unlike both immediately preceding eight-rung cases, the two nine-rung ordinary matching complexes are pure five-sphere wedges, while the Möbius twist changes the sphere rank by exactly two. Integral homotopy classification is finer than Betti counts, without claiming an infinite-width theorem.
